osf_menon_2022_project.upgrade_finding: SM13's per-record RAYYAN-EXCLUSION-REASONS tags upgrade 12B's excluded-record labelling for Menon_2022 specifically from 'independent dual-human/LLM adjudication' (decision 2's fallback) to 'the original authors' own structured exclusion reason' for all 901 excluded records, 281 of which are additionally PMC-indexed. No equivalent per-record extraction dataset exists for the 75 included SRs beyond SM06's bibliographic fields -- Menon_2022's own 'extraction' (SM05/SM07, CREST_Basic) scores SR methodological rigour, not PICO-style study findings, so it cannot be reused as ground truth for this chapter's 9-field extraction schema; 12B.2 must still independently extract from full text for whatever included subset it selects.

balanced_subset_design.note: 6 included + 6 excluded, all licence-verified CC BY 4.0 via Europe PMC (isOpenAccess=Y, license='cc by'), chosen for journal diversity (included) and exclusion-reason diversity (excluded). Full text has not been downloaded for any of the 12 -- licence verification only, per the standing no-spend/no-download gate.
